param: L Recruitment rate into children (births); assumed balanced with deaths over short outbreak period
x_U Un-monitored children vaccination rate
x_M Monitored children vaccination rate
x_A Adult vaccination rate (set to 0 during data period)
β_C Transmission rate parameter for children
β_A Transmission rate parameter for adults (lower than children)
m Natural death rate (1/(72*52) per week)
γ Recovery rate (rate of becoming immune after infection)
j Maturation rate from child to adult (1/(15*52) per week)
e Residual susceptibility factor among un-monitored vaccinated (1 - vaccine effectiveness); vaccine effectiveness = (1-e)
h_A Rate of becoming immune among un-monitored vaccinated adults (set to 0 during data period)
h_U Rate of becoming immune among un-monitored vaccinated children
h_M Rate of becoming immune among monitored vaccinated children
σ Progression rate from exposed to infectious (1/incubation period)
δ Disease-induced death rate
q Reporting fraction used to map model incidence to observed weekly cases
a Fraction of district population participating in the effective contact network (scaling used in fitting)
N_total Total modeled population (children + adults) at t=0
N_C0 Initial total children population in modeled contact network (Table 2)
N_A0 Initial total adult population in modeled contact network (Table 2)
